newsitem.title: UK: BG gains as report raises regulation hopes.
newsitem.headline: BG gains as report raises regulation hopes.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc rose on Monday after a press report said the group was set for a victory over regulator Ofgas in a price dispute being examined by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Extending its gains of the past two sessions, the stock was up 3p at 176-1/2p by 0746 GMT in heavy trade of 2.4 million shares.

The Sunday Times newspaper cited unnamed industry analysts as saying the commission was expected to rule in BG's favour in a key issue relating to the depreciation of its assets -- which will have a significant effect on its cash flow and ability to maintain its dividend.
The paper said the ruling could mark a turning point in the fortunes of BG, which spun off its natural gas distribution business Centrica Plc earlier this year.
A spokeswoman for BG said it was company policy not to comment on market speculation and said the report remained a matter for the monopolies commmission.
BG shares bounced last week after touching a year's low of 156p on April 1.
